--- sshd-unix-local.socket
# Automatically generated by systemd-ssh-generator

[Unit]
Description=OpenSSH Server Socket (systemd-ssh-generator, AF_UNIX Local)
Documentation=man:systemd-ssh-generator(8)

[Socket]
ListenStream=/run/ssh-unix-local/socket
Accept=yes
PollLimitIntervalSec=30s
PollLimitBurst=50
--- sshd-unix-local@.service
# This is required to prevent systemd-ssh-generator from creating a default
# file in its place.  The main change vs. upstream is the addition of Wants=
# for our sshgenkeys.service, which systemd otherwise doesn't know about.

[Unit]
After=network.target sshdgenkeys.service
Description=OpenSSH Per-Connection Server Daemon
Documentation=man:sshd(8) man:sshd_config(5)
Wants=sshdgenkeys.service

[Service]
ExecStart=-/usr/bin/sshd -i -o "AuthorizedKeysFile ${CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY}/ssh.ephemeral-authorized_keys-all .ssh/authorized_keys"
ImportCredential=ssh.ephemeral-authorized_keys-all
StandardInput=socket
--- swap-swapfile.swap

[Unit]
Documentation=man:fstab(5) man:systemd-fstab-generator(8)
SourcePath=/etc/fstab

[Swap]
What=/swap/swapfile
Options=defaults,pri=0

[Unit]
Description=Remount Root and Kernel File Systems
Documentation=man:systemd-remount-fs.service(8)
Documentation=https://systemd.io/API_FILE_SYSTEMS

DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-fsck-root.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target local-fs.target
Wants=local-fs-pre.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target
Before=shutdown.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/lib/systemd/systemd-remount-fs
